title: Calendar Fixture (one BS month)
description:
Schema for each per-month calendar JSON under packages/pilot-fixtures/pilots/<pilot-id>/calendar/. One file per BS month (baisakh.json ... chait.json). The fixture holds every per-day event in the month — holidays, programs, exam-window days, term boundaries, AY boundaries, and other school events. Multi-day holiday blocks live separately in holidays-consolidated.json (C1.5); per-day entries here may reference a blockId.

Cross-year markers (e.g., next-AY result-publish date) intentionally live in academic-structure.json (C1.4), NOT in these monthly files — the monthly files cover events within the primary AY's BS year only.

month.description: BS month slug. Must match the file's basename (baisakh → baisakh.json).

events.description: Per-day operational events for this month. Empty array is valid for months with no events.

notes.description: Optional free-form note for the operator who maintains this fixture. Not consumed by code.

bsDate.description: BS date in YYYY/MM/DD format. The MM portion must match the parent file's 'month' (catch via cross-validation in the C1.7 loader, not at schema time — schema-only validation lets a misplaced entry slip).

eventType.description: Event classification. The 6-value enum lets `metadata` carry the variation rather than exploding the enum (e.g., 'national holiday' vs 'religious holiday' is metadata.category).

eventName.description: Operator-facing display name (e.g. 'Dashain Day 1', 'Quiz Contest', 'Term 1 Begins'). Per invariant 13, this is fixture DATA — pilot/school names may appear here; they are NOT engine code.

metadata.description: Type-specific extra fields. Not strict — different event types use different keys.

category.description: Used by 'holiday' and 'program' events to disambiguate.

blockId.description: For multi-day holiday days: references the entry in holidays-consolidated.json. The loader expands blockId → block range to render UIs without re-walking every per-day row.

termId.description: For exam_window / term_boundary / program (when applicable): references the term in academic-structure.json.

boundary.description: For term_boundary / ay_boundary: which side of the boundary this date marks.

sourceTermId.description: For program events: which term this program is associated with (e.g. a Saraswati Puja celebration ties to the term it falls within).

nextAyId.description: Reserved for cross-year markers — but those live in academic-structure.json (C1.4), so this should rarely be used here.
